name: simulate-retirement-action-preflight-boundary
why: Measured reach for the annual named-action routing and conversion-linked withdrawal preflight extracted from simulatePlan. Existing linked-pair, named-QCD, ordinary-withdrawal, and multi-year corpus members exercise current-year partitioning, normal executor routing, complete linked-group request assembly, floored fundability, provisional and proven release selection, and every caller output handoff in all four equivalence modes. Direct contract tests own cross-kind and QCD-only schedule collisions, mixed-kind blocking, one-cent-short capacity on both legs, shared-withdrawal contention, current-year exclusion including QCDs, frozen results, hostile release getters, and proven-authority forwarding. Hostile delegation tests separately prove the caller consumes ordinary and QCD execution routes, cross-executor QCD collision routing, mixed-kind blocking, the complete linked-group request union, and the shared linked-group assessment instead of rebuilding those decisions inline.

readingTheCounts: A member count proves at least one line in the named range executed. Reach additionally fails on a cold executable whole line inside a reached range. Direct coordinator tests own collision routing, mixed-kind widening, insufficient or unrepresentable capacity on both group legs, contested groups, year exclusion, frozen result arrays, one-read release snapshots, and proven-authority forwarding. Hostile delegation owns exact consumption of ordinary/QCD routing, mixed-kind blocking, group requests, and the shared group verdict. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every ternary or compound operand sharing a physical line, so reported cold sub-line regions must be read alongside those focused tests.
